name: Cell-type contact network
author: PointillViz authors
description: Which cell types touch which, from a Delaunay triangulation of the cells, as a network and a matrix corrected for abundance.
long_description: Triangulates each section's cells and counts every edge as a contact. Draws the cell types as a network and as a matrix, coloured by enrichment over abundance.

params.name: field
params.label: Cell-type column
params.help:
Selects the annotation whose groups are the network's nodes.
Cell types, unless the dataset has none or you choose another column.

params.name: max_distance
params.label: Longest contact (microns)
params.help:
Drops contacts longer than this, so that cells across a gap do not count as touching.
0 keeps every contact. In the dataset's own coordinates when it records no physical size.

params.name: cutoff
params.label: Arrow cutoff (%)
params.help:
Draws an arrow from one type to another only when at least this share of the first type's contacts are with the second.
The matrix has no cutoff.

params.name: max_types
params.label: Cell types shown
params.help:
Shows only this many of the most abundant types, in the network and in the matrix.
The others still count in every share, and the download holds them all.
